text: I have been trying to get through for nearly forty minutes so I'll just type it. My granddaughter Ellie is 2. Temp 38 exactly. Earlier she banged her head on the coffee table edge, howled straight away, and now she's back to normal, playing with her blocks and chattering like nothing happened. She was sick once about an hour after, but she's had juice and water since and kept it all down. Her mother is away and I would like someone to tell me whether I need to do anything tonight.
